details:
Our client "Paperly" is seeking a Mid/Senior Software Engineer to join their team!
Are you ready to be at the forefront of EdTech innovation? Join Paperly, a leading Australian company, as a Senior Software Engineer and play a crucial role in revolutionising school processes globally. This is an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, contribute to product development, and grow with a fast-scaling venture-backed startup.
About Our Client
Paperly is a pioneering Australian EdTech company on a mission to streamline and automate manual processes in schools worldwide. Backed by venture capital and experiencing rapid growth, Paperly offers a dynamic work environment where you can make a significant impact and be part of an exciting global journey.
What you'll be doing?
Product Development:
Design, develop, and deploy solutions, working closely with engineers and product managers to deliver features to global customers.
Technical Expertise:
Build and debug product features primarily in PHP/Laravel, with opportunities to work with other languages and environments.
Cloud Infrastructure Management:
Play a key role in managing AWS infrastructure, including environment configuration, deployment automation, and security best practices.
DevOps Implementation:
Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipeline development for scalable, secure deployments.
Cross-functional Collaboration:
Facilitate knowledge sharing and advocate for engineering needs to non-technical team members.
Leadership and Innovation:
Take initiative in achieving goals, improving processes, and identifying opportunities for cross-team collaboration.
Customer Support:
Assist with escalations from customer onboarding and support teams, ensuring optimal user experience.
Agile Practices:
Actively participate in agile ceremonies and code reviews, contributing to a collaborative development environment.
Who are they looking for?
Strong Technical Foundation:
You have robust computer science and software engineering fundamentals, with a passion for algorithms and performance.
Backend Expertise:
You're highly competent in backend development, with deep knowledge of PHP & Laravel.
Cloud Proficiency:
You have hands-on experience designing and managing cloud infrastructure in AWS.
Versatile Skill Set:
You're comfortable working across both application and infrastructure layers of a product.
Solution-Oriented Mindset:
You can identify solution options, weigh trade-offs, and propose scalable software architectures to solve business problems.
Effective Communication:
You have a strong ability to communicate technical concepts to various audiences, including non-technical stakeholders.
Problem-Solving Skills:
You excel at breaking large projects into manageable tasks and delivering through collaboration.
Relevant Experience:
You have at least 5 years of commercial experience building software products.
Qualifications:
You hold a qualification in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
Security Clearance:
You can provide a National Police Certificate or Working with Children Check.
Why you should consider this opportunity?
Our client offers an attractive remuneration package and other benefits, such as:
Flexible work-from-home options for a better work-life balance
A relaxed, friendly startup culture that fosters creativity and innovation
Unparalleled learning opportunities in a fast-growing environment
Direct collaboration with senior leadership, including the CEO
How to apply
Ready to join this role? Click Apply now to submit your resume and share your availability and expected salary with us!
We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we're looking for!
All information received will be kept strictly confidential and will be used only for employment-related purposes.
